doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Appointment to act in the Post of Director General of the Department of National Botanic Gardens on full time basis
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - Ms. H.C.P. Jayaweera, who served as the Director General of the Department of National Botanic Gardens, retired from the public service upon reaching the age of 60 on 2026-09-14. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to appoint Mr. M.M.D.J. Senarathna, the senior most Officer in Grade I of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service currently serving in the said Department to act in the vacant post of Director General of the Department of National Botanic Gardens on a full-time basis, with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.
